column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - reviewed placements of statically linked VC6 SP3
# runtime code. Each row is one COFF section of a pinned archive member
# basename, 1-based COFF section number) at its retail RVA; `size` is the
# section's raw size. Section 0 is a linker import thunk from the named
# import library. Rows sharing one RVA are ICF-folded COMDATs whose symbols
# `homm3 verify library-code` re-proves every row on each build: unrelocated
# bytes equal retail and every relocation resolves to its symbol's placed
# definition, import slot, game definition, or a consistently based datum.
# Only exact rows (and 0xCC alignment fill between two exact neighbours) are
# evidence: `copies=N` the section is byte-identical in N members;
# `member-by-continuity` the member continues its neighbours' link-order run;
# member kept); `twin-by-*` a non-COMDAT section identical to another
# member's, chosen by link-order continuity or by the symbol that retail
# code references; `icf` folded with the other rows at this RVA.
